entities.name: tiled hall behind the white compound wall and the gateway, west of the long house (roof only)
entities.what: A tiled hall on the north bank behind (north of) the white compound wall and the roofed gateway, west of the long house, seen only as its roof and its slatted west bay: a broad roof of tiles from a west eave corner over the slatted screen (S2.str.slat_screen_22375) running east, where its tile rows run on unbroken into the long house's roof, cut off by the silk's top edge; under the roof's west end the slatted front with its capping rail stands about 115 px of v behind the white wall's foot. The rest of its front is hidden behind the white wall and the gateway; nothing hangs on it and no writing shows.
entities.vis: part: only the roof and the slatted west bay show; the front east of u 22437 is behind the white wall and the gateway, the west bay's foot behind the split willow's east leg; the roof's back is cut by the silk's top edge
entities.note: SECOND PASS (west): a painted roof with no footprint (map/README.md rule 6). S2.bld.long_house_22780's note says 'whether the roof over u 22320-22650 (v 20-200, behind the screen and the white wall) is this house's west part or a second building is not settled', and S2.str.slat_screen_22375's reading (b) names 'the big tiled roof spanning u ~22320-22810 at v 20-200 (recorded with the long house)'; but the long house's footprint starts at u 22650 (sw (22650, 406), nw est (22786, 256)), so nothing would be built under the roof's west 330 px. Strokes (crops z_bigroof.jpg, z_roofw.jpg, z_screen.jpg): the roof's west eave corner at (22326, 104) with its west verge rising to (22405, 50) and on to the silk's top edge (v ~18); tile rows fill u 22320-22650, v 20-200 and run on east without a ridge end, gable or break into the long house's roof (one chimney, at u 22697, on the long house's part); the slatted front (slats u 22320-22437, top rail v 122, a mid rail v ~150, foot (22320, 185)-(22435, 190)) stands right under the roof's west eave. The white wall's foot (22437-22532, v 302-312) and the gateway's sill (v 306-322) are 110-125 px of v further south, and the white wall's coping (v 173-197) reaches only to the slatted front's foot level: so the wall and the gate stand in front of this hall with a narrow yard (about 2 m at the depth rate) between them, and the gateway's own small roof sits under this roof's eave. FOOTPRINT: sw is the slatted front's west foot (measured); the front is carried east along the slats' foot line (slope +0.04) to se (22640, 199, est) at the long house's west corner post (u ~22650); back corners est 150 px of v behind along slope -1.1 (structures_w's placeholder rule for this stretch), at the silk's top edge. The footprint touches neither the gateway's (back corners v 297-300) nor the long house's (its west side runs (22650, 406)->(22786, 256)). READINGS: (a, taken) a separate hall behind a compound wall and a gateway, whose west bay front is the slatted screen (S2.str.slat_screen_22375, reading (b) of that entity); (b) the west part of the long house under one continuous roof, set back behind the wall and gate (the long house is then L-shaped: fold this footprint into S2.bld.long_house_22780 and drop this entity). The restyle also draws one continuous roof over a lattice front behind the white wall. Main point u 22320: S2's (west range). FRAME AGENT (second pass accepted): reading (a), conf low. If the lead takes reading (b), the footprint folds into S2.bld.long_house_22780 and this entity is retired.

entities.name: two straight stems behind the long top roof, west of the willow (a small tree, faint)
entities.what: Two straight, dark, nearly parallel stems rising from behind the east end of the long tiled roof at the top of the silk to the silk's top edge, about 15 px apart; their crown is above the silk and their foot behind the building: a small tree (or a forked trunk) standing behind the roof, west of the willow S2.tree.willow_27925.
entities.vis: part: only the stems between the roof's top edge (v ~50) and the silk's top edge (v ~18) show; foot behind the roof, crown cut by the silk's top edge
entities.note: SECOND PASS (east): not an entity; t10 folded these strokes into S2.tree.willow_27925's crown ('whips hang over u 27800-27995', crown_w (27800, 40)). Strokes (zoom 5, scratchpad S2_second_east/z_stems.jpg): west stem u 27778-27788, east stem u 27794-27800, both from the silk's top edge (v ~18) down to the roof's top edge (v ~48-52), even in width over their length, of the same dark ink as the trunks nearby. TWO READINGS: (a) a separate small tree behind the roof (recorded); (b) the westmost hanging whips or branches of S2.tree.willow_27925 (the restyle paints hanging willow whips here, i_stems.jpg). For (a): the stems are 6-10 px thick, 2-3 times a willow whip's width on this scan (the whips behind the 望楼饭铺, n_willow2.jpg, are 2-4 px), straight and parallel; between them and the willow's trunk complex (u ~27860-27960, n_toptrees.jpg, n_willow27925.jpg) the silk at u 27805-27855, v 20-50 carries only faint dabs, no branch joining them. Base est where the roof hides them, as for the other trees here; the true foot is north of the building (S2.bld.top_long_house_27560's east end; t10's 'north shed'), a builder choice:. The tree count matters to the user: drop it if the lead reads whips. Crops: scratchpad S2_second_east/z_stems.jpg, n_toptrees.jpg, n_willow27925.jpg, i_stems.jpg.
